source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Bumpers, p.14-6

procedures.title: Front bumper (Corvette): remove and install
steps: (Removal) Put the car on a hoist.
Take off both decorative radiator grilles.
Remove the bolts holding the face bar to the brackets and braces.
Remove the bolts holding the lower edge of the bumper guards to the crossmember.
Lift off the bumper with face bar and guards.
notes: Face bar and guards come off without disturbing the braces, brackets or license plate assembly.
See figure 8 in the manual (exploded front bumper).
